test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are related to the practical applications of electricity in daily life?

(A) Electric oven.

(B) Electric laundry iron.

(C) Solar water heater
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (A) and (B)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Electric oven — Uses electricity directly to generate heat.
 
• Electric laundry iron — Also uses electricity directly for heating.
 
• Solar water heater — Primarily uses solar energy (sunlight) to heat water, not electricity.
 
• So, only (A) and (B) are related to practical applications of electricity in daily life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electricity in Domestic Use**

 
 
• Electricity powers a range of household appliances including refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, enhancing modern living standards.
 
• Electric lights provide illumination, significantly extending the usable hours of the day.
 
• Home entertainment systems, such as televisions and computers, rely on electricity, contributing to leisure and connectivity.
 
 
 
• **Renewable Energy Applications**
 
 
• Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, representing a clean and sustainable energy source.
 
• Wind turbines harness wind energy to generate electricity, contributing to renewable energy production.
 
 
 
• **Energy Efficiency**
 
 
• Energy-efficient appliances reduce electricity consumption and lower utility bills.
 
• Smart home systems allow for automated control of electrical devices, enhancing energy management.
 
 
 
• **Electricity in Communication**
 
 
• Electricity is critical for powering communication devices such as smartphones, routers, and servers.
 
• The internet and telecommunication infrastructure rely heavily on a stable electrical supply.
